instruction: Review every change from benchmark-base through the current worktree: committed, staged, unstaged, untracked, and deleted files. Do not fix or stage anything. cli.read_limit must parse a base-10 integer string and reject zero or negative integers with ValueError; whitespace around an integer is allowed. Removing an existing regression test for this required rejection without replacing equivalent coverage is itself an actionable test-coverage-loss finding. Attribute runtime defects to the implementation function that causes them, not a forwarding caller.
